hypothesis: Additional labeled recording days and equal sampling of day/session/class strata improve held-out-day performance compared with training only on 19–20 June.
architecture: unchanged frozen MobileNetV3 Small plus one-layer GRU, hidden size 32, dropout 0.3
sampling: inverse training counts per date/group/class, replacement, one training-set-length draw per epoch; no validation-derived weights
normalization: mean/std of training video-mean embeddings only
epoch_selection: maximum arithmetic mean of validation macro-F1 per day, earliest exact tie
heldout_policy: Acquire, decode and evaluate 18 June only if all validation gates pass; one fixed seed-42 candidate and seed-42 baseline, no further tuning after that examination.
scope: Day-disjoint comparison within AV-FFIA; no claim of other species, farms, hunger, feed dosage or realized savings. Earlier held-out published evaluations remain evaluations of the old model only.
